name: Mark of Order builds to 5 stacks and expires without self-refreshing (#13443)
contract: Mark of Order 704488 applies Mark of Order 806269 (20 s duration, StackAmount 5) when Fortify Timeline 804491 heals. Every 1 s, 806269 triggers 806270 (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_STACKS +1 on 806269). Live Ascension combat logs (2026-08-29-18.43.47 WoWCombatLog.txt) confirm 806269 grows to 5 stacks over 4 s and expires at 20.00 s without resetting its timer on 806270 ticks. Previously ModifyAscensionAuraStacks called Aura::ModStackAmount(+1), whose RefreshTimers reset 806269 back to 20,000 ms every second forever. After applying 806269 via Fortify Timeline 804491, it must reach 5 stacks, then after 4 more seconds have remaining duration at most 15,000 ms (unfixed stays 19,000-20,000 ms), and then expire naturally within its 20 s window.

steps.label: SETUP: no Mark of Order before casting Fortify Timeline
SETUP: Fortify Timeline applies Mark of Order
SETUP: Mark of Order builds to 5 stacks
Wait past full stacks to verify duration counts down
DISCRIMINATING: Mark of Order duration is not refreshed back to 20 s at full stacks
DISCRIMINATING: Mark of Order expires naturally instead of lasting forever
